title: ERGON: sub-features of ergative flagging (Grambank GB409) for 196 languages
description: ERGON expands Grambank feature GB409 (Is there any ergative alignment of flagging?) into 24 binary sub-features coded from published grammatical descriptions for 196 languages (164 with ergative flagging). Distributed as a CLDF StructureDataset with page-level sources, a coding protocol, build and validation scripts.
